ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between high-intensity distal lobes (white) and low-intensity central/trailing regions (black). Estimated pixel ratio of approximately 0.4:0.6 white-to-black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous high-intensity (white) regions occupy the distal halves of both lobes. The central region, including the peduncle connection and a thick band along the trailing edge, is characterized by contiguous low-intensity (black) pixels. High-frequency speckling and mottling occur at the interface between intensity zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, distinct V-shaped central notch. Calculated interior angle is approximately 55 degrees with significant pixel depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, irregular serrations along the primary lobes. Significant high-amplitude, high-frequency pixel clusters (barnacle-induced irregularities) are present at both distal tips, creating a non-linear termination.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following the trailing edge from the notch to the tips. The distal tips exhibit a sharp upward-pointing orientation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast circular pixel clusters (rosettes) localized on the extreme outer margins of both the left and right tips. Scattered small high-intensity punctate spots are visible within the low-intensity central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct parallel, low-intensity linear marks (rake marks) are detected on the high-intensity left lobe, oriented diagonally. One prominent linear mark is visible on the high-intensity right lobe near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal tips; distinct parallel rake marks (linear abrasions) on the left ventral lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced black speckling pattern forming a transition zone between the solid black central area and the white distal patches.
